record.original_question:
Let Γ = Z^n and let A ∈ GL_n(R) be expansive, meaning all eigenvalues λ of A satisfy |λ| > 1. A function ψ ∈ L2(R^n) is well-localized if both ψ and ψ̂ have polynomial decay: ψ(x)=O(|x|^{−N}) and ψ̂(ξ)=O(|ξ|^{−N}) for some large N>0.

For what expansive dilations A do there exist well-localized wavelets associated with (A,Z^n), possibly with multiple generators?

   Daubechies [30, Chapter 1] asked whether “there exist orthonormal wavelet bases (neces-
sarily not associated with a multiresolution analysis), with good time-frequency localization,
and with irrational a.” A partial answer was given by Chui and Shi [27] who showed that
all wavelets associated with dilation factors a such that aj is irrational for all j ≥ 1 must be
minimally supported frequency (MSF). A complete answer was given by the first author [9]
who proved the following result.

an orthonormal wavelet associated with a, then at least one of ψ l is poorly localized in time.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Gamma = \mathbb{Z}^n$ act on $\mathbb{R}^n$ by translations, and let $A \in GL_n(\mathbb{R})$ be an expansive matrix, i.e., every eigenvalue $\lambda$ of $A$ satisfies $|\lambda| > 1$. For a finite collection $\Psi = \{\psi^1, \dots, \psi^L\} \subset L^2(\mathbb{R}^n)$, the associated wavelet system is
$$\{ |\det A|^{j/2}\, \psi^l(A^j x - k) : 1 \le l \le L,\ j \in \mathbb{Z},\ k \in \mathbb{Z}^n \}.$$
We call $\Psi$ an orthonormal wavelet associated with $(A, \mathbb{Z}^n)$ if this system is an orthonormal basis of $L^2(\mathbb{R}^n)$. A function $\psi \in L^2(\mathbb{R}^n)$ is said to be well-localized if there exists $N > 0$ such that
$$\psi(x) = O(|x|^{-N})\ \text{as}\ |x| \to \infty, \qquad \widehat{\psi}(\xi) = O(|\xi|^{-N})\ \text{as}\ |\xi| \to \infty.$$
A wavelet $\Psi$ is well-localized if every $\psi^l$ is well-localized.

Characterize precisely the expansive matrices $A \in GL_n(\mathbb{R})$ for which there exists a well-localized orthonormal wavelet (with possibly multiple generators) associated with $(A, \mathbb{Z}^n)$.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem of characterizing expansive dilations admitting well-localized orthonormal wavelets (with possibly multiple generators) on $\mathbb{Z}^n$ appears to remain open. It is listed among open problems in wavelet theory; partial necessary conditions are known (e.g., divisibility of the number of generators by $|\det A|-1$ for integer dilations via the wavelet dimension function), but a full characterization has not been established.

status_evidence.title: Wavelets for Non-expanding Dilations and the Lattice Counting Estimate
status_evidence.snippet: Studies of wavelet existence for various dilation classes; well-localized characterization not resolved.
status_evidence.claim: Related literature treats existence questions but does not provide a complete characterization for the well-localized case.
